title: Pure Mannadium
summary: Mannadium cards with the Visas Starfrost and Peaceful Planet Calarium they name, plus generic Synchros and staples. Mannadium Riumheart has 1500 ATK/2100 DEF, the stats the other Mannadium cards look for. It summons itself by destroying your monster and searches any Mannadium card. The Level 2 Mannadium Tuners summon themselves next to Visas Starfrost or any 1500/2100 monster, and each one summons a Mannadium Tuner from the Deck when destroyed. Mannadium Abscission destroys your own monster to search Calarium, which in turn searches a Mannadium or Visas. Mannadium Trisukta, the newest card, revives a Level 2 Tuner and resets Tuners to Level 2 for more Synchros. Mannadium Prime-Heart attacks once per Tuner used. Mannadium Reframing negates any activation while you control a Synchro.

allow.Peaceful Planet Calarium: Mannadium Abscission searches it, and it searches a Mannadium or Visas Starfrost.
